svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: 10-minute Locust load test
svg.desc: Simulated users rise in stages from 50 to 300 and fall back to 100 over ten minutes; requests per second follow the load, peaking near 285. 106,910 requests, 1 failure.
svg.text: 106,910 requests · 1 failure · up to 300 simulated users · 17 Nov 2026
Throwaway stress stack on one laptop: 4 web processes, 2 AI workers, a fake LLM with injected provider failures. One run - not a performance guarantee.
